comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
In order to grind the Boston Academic Association thesis "Fishing 1" and "Fishing 2", the best place is immediately outside Cape Town, as you can fish both Mako Shark and Great White Shark in large quantities.
It's also reasonable good place to grind Storage, as Mako Shark can be used on a R14 Storage recipe. You can use "Miser's chains" to add temporary +5 Storage, allowing you to do the R14 recipe right at R9.

Stats with R16+1 Fishing - Immediately Outside Cape Town
Sardine: 2433 (37.7%)
Mako Shark: 1305 (20.2%)
Great White Shark: 2712 (42%)
